hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def word_prob(count, class_total, vocab_size, alpha):
    return round((count + alpha) / (class_total + alpha * vocab_size), 5)

print(word_prob(0, 1000, 300, 1.0))
print(word_prob(25, 1000, 300, 1.0))
print(word_prob(25, 1000, 300, 0.1))
```
